astral.system.description:
Creatures of the Astral

Incorporeal: immune to all damage except necrotic and radiant.

No negative conditions affect them except Off Guard and Burning, unless the ability's effect directly names the creature type as its target.

construct.system.description: Monolith: strong resistance (DR 5) to all damage types. Adamantine weapons ignore Monolith (and hit constructs with a bonus; see materials).
construct.name: Construct

demon.system.description: Vulnerable to radiant. Plus one strong and one weak resistance, depending on the specific creature (a fire demon against fire, an ice demon against cold...).
